title: WINOGRANDE: An Adversarial Winograd Schema Challenge at Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Applying the AFLITE adversarial filtering algorithm to detect and remove instances with spurious statistical correlations and word associations based on pre-computed neural embeddings, and evaluating the drop in model performance on the debiased dataset.

Evaluating models on the Winogender dataset to measure the difference in coreference resolution accuracy between cases where a pronoun matches the occupation's statistically majority gender versus when it does not.
